# CyberThreatIntelligence — Advanced Learning & Research
Repository: https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence
Language: pt-BR
Purpose: Curated, educational, defensive CTI links and study guides. NOT a live threat feed or an intelligence API.
Learning-path editorial review: 2026-10-23

## Core knowledge
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/docs/01-fundamentos.md : terms, CTI levels, intelligence questions
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/docs/02-metodologia.md : analytical workflow, source evaluation and hypotheses
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/docs/04-trilhas.md : study progression
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/docs/05-estudos-de-caso.md : fictional examples and historical analysis
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/docs/06-relatorios.md : reporting and TLP
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/docs/08-auditoria-e-creditos.md : curation decisions and source provenance

## Machine-readable resources
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/resources/catalog.json

## Responsible use
Use links as discovery leads, not as independent verification of claims. Prefer primary sources, retain dates and attribution, and never treat model-generated speculation as confirmed threat intelligence.


## Advanced curriculum
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/learning-paths/cti-48-semanas.md : 48 weeks, 576 proposed study hours
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/learning-paths/soc-especialista.md : complementary 24 weeks, 288 proposed hours
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/docs/09-normas-e-rfcs.md : SOC standards, versions and historical RFC caveats
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/labs/README.md : two offline executable labs and four guided exercises
- https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/CyberThreatIntelligence/blob/main/assessments/rubrica.md : assessment and evidence requirements

No professional certification or job guarantee. Live SIEM/SOAR, Ansible and dynamic malware environments are not deployed by this repository. Distinguish hypothetical evidence, actual observations and inference.
